title: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
slides: What if AI quietly solved what mathematicians couldn't?
OpenAI built a model to tackle unsolved math problems.
Its proof convinced experts—but the method stayed hidden.
Researchers now face a black-box colleague they can't audit.
Ask any AI result: can you verify its reasoning?
thread_text:
1. Proof Without a Window

OpenAI's model solved an unsolved math problem. Experts verified the proof, but the method stayed hidden.

2. A Black Box That Proves

Only the final answer was shown. No steps, no logic, no way to check the path taken.

3. Colleague You Can't Audit

Researchers now work beside an AI whose reasoning is invisible. You can't debug what you can't see.

4. Trust Without Trace

A correct result doesn't mean a repeatable process. If the method is secret, the proof is a one-time trick.

5. Ask for the Steps

Next time an AI gives you an answer, ask it to show its work. Can you verify the reasoning? Try it today.

Ask any AI to show its reasoning.

instagram.caption:
A mathematical proof just got verified by experts who still can't see how it was found.

An AI model cracked a problem mathematicians hadn't solved. Only the final answer was shown—no steps, no logic, no path to check. 😶

So the proof works, but nobody can reproduce the reasoning behind it.

If you use AI to solve anything, you're trusting an answer you can't audit. A correct result isn't a repeatable process. 🔍

Next time an AI answers you, ask it to show its work. Can you actually verify the steps it took? 🧮
